name: percepta
description: PERCEPTA - On-device Visual Perception for Light-weight Browser Agents

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,DEMO" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:demo"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../demo-site && npm install
scripts.install:playwright: cd backend && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:suite
